title: Garlic Mashed Potatoes
description: Potatoes boiled with whole garlic cloves, then mashed together with milk, Parmesan and butter.

ingredients.note: baking potatoes, peeled and cubed (about 7 cups)

steps.heading: Boil
steps.text: Put the potatoes and garlic in a saucepan, cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes; drain.

steps.heading: Mash
steps.text: Put the drained potatoes and garlic in a mixing bowl, add the remaining ingredients and mix until smooth.
